description: This Java class 'PlaceholderFactory' provides static factory methods for creating instances of various placeholder-related objects such as Placeholders, PlaceholderResolvers, and ExpressionResolvers within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating specific placeholder types, resolver instances, and expression resolvers with different configurations.

classes.name: PlaceholderFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing static factory methods for creating placeholder and expression resolver instances.

methods.name: newHeadersPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a new instance of HeadersPlaceholder.

methods.name: newThingPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a new instance of ThingPlaceholder.

methods.name: newPolicyPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a new instance of PolicyPlaceholder.

methods.name: newEntityPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a new instance of EntityPlaceholder.

methods.name: newTopicPathPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a new instance of TopicPathPlaceholder.

methods.name: newRequestPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of a Placeholder with prefix 'request'.

methods.name: newPlaceholderResolver
methods.description: Creates a new PlaceholderResolver based on a given Placeholder and optional placeholder source.

methods.name: newPlaceholderResolverForValidation
methods.description: Creates a PlaceholderResolver for validation purposes, without a placeholder source.

methods.name: newExpressionResolver
methods.description: Creates an ExpressionResolver initialized with given PlaceholderResolvers.

methods.name: newExpressionResolver
methods.description: Creates an ExpressionResolver with a list of PlaceholderResolvers.

methods.name: newExpressionResolver
methods.description: Creates an ExpressionResolver with a single Placeholder and placeholder source.

methods.name: newExpressionResolverForValidation
methods.description: Creates an ExpressionResolver for validation with zero or more placeholders.

methods.name: newExpressionResolverForValidation
methods.description: Creates an ExpressionResolver for validation with placeholders and a dummy replacement string.

methods.name: newSourceAddressPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a new instance of SourceAddressPlaceholder.

methods.name: newConnectionIdPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ConnectionIdPlaceholder.
